description: Sort a feature list into must, should and not now using 15 explicit rules on each feature's tags (core_job, revenue, compliance, trust_safety, onboarding, measurement, retention, integration, automation, admin, growth, analytics, customization, platform, scale, delight), whether it could be done by hand at first, and how many buyers asked for it. Dependencies of a must become must. Should-haves fill the build window by value per effort point in dependency order. Returns each feature with its tier, the rule and the reason, effort totals against capacity, and when the must-haves do not fit, the specific cuts that would make them fit. Rejects duplicate ids, unknown dependencies and cycles with the chain named.

charge_at_launch.description: True if buyers pay from launch. Default true.

depends_on.description: Ids of features that must exist first.

effort.description: xs (1 point), s (2), m (3, default), l (5), xl (8).

manual_alternative.description: True if a person could do this by hand for the first buyers.

points.description: Effort points, overrides effort. A builder clears 5 a week by default.

requested_by.description: How many buyers asked for it.

tags.description: What the feature does: core_job, revenue, compliance, trust_safety, onboarding, measurement, retention, integration, automation, admin, growth, analytics, customization, platform, scale, delight.

points_per_week.description: Effort points one builder clears in a week. Default 5.

name: cut_mvp
title: Cut an MVP
